summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Dead City HD completed successfully. All lobby features, gameplay mechanics, and mobile responsiveness verified. Desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844) viewports tested with no horizontal overflow. All 5 tabs, 4 operators, 8 weapons, 9 outfit slots, dog companion, settings, and in-game controls working correctly.

notes.spanish_ui: All UI text is in Spanish as required (e.g., 'INICIAR OPERACIÓN', 'Operadores', 'Arsenal', 'Compañero', 'Ajustes')
